concealed_damage_flags.rule: Water stain on a ceiling means water entered from above the ceiling.
concealed_damage_flags.recommendation: Inspect the roof or the plumbing / wet room above; expect wet insulation and ceiling board beyond the visible stain.

scope.description: Cut out and replace water-damaged ceiling board
Moisture mapping / thermal imaging of the flagged surface and cavity
Inspection opening (300 x 300 mm) into the cavity and make good
